### About Wet Paws Mobile Pet Grooming

Locally owned and operated

Wet Paws Mobile Pet Grooming is based in Albuquerque, NM, and began serving pets and pet parents in July 2022.

We founded the company to serve the growing need for mobile pet grooming services in the greater Albuquerque and Rio Rancho areas. With several dogs of our own and busy schedules, we started as mobile pet grooming clients in 2016 and loved the convenience and quality. The demand for mobile grooming only grew during COVID-19 as retail salons were closed and many people worked from home (and still are) or attended school remotely. As a result, many mobile groomers were booked months in advance, had a waiting list, or were not accepting new clients.

Mobile is for you

We serve busy professionals and families with hectic schedules. We serve pet parents who don't drive or cannot easily (or safely) transport their pets to a grooming salon. We are a great option for pets who get stressed, anxious, or car sick. Let our state-of-the-art mobile grooming salon and trained grooming professional come to you instead. Mobile pet grooming is for everyone. With online scheduling, e-mail/text reminders, the ability to keep a payment card on file, and electronic forms with e-signature, we're your "easy button" for pet grooming.
